messages:
Sam G: Onboarding reported a 401 'insufficient_scope' after copying the quickstart curl.
Harper L: Can you paste what they ran?
Sam G: Exactly from README: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-redwood-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Harper L: Two problems we keep seeing: (1) scoped API keys now require the inference.write scope for POSTs and README doesn't mention it, (2) some sample apps still use REDWOOD_KEY vs README's REDWOOD_API_KEY so copy/paste fails. Also Windows cmd quoting breaks the curl when folks paste single quotes.
Docs Bot: docs-ci: detected REDWOOD_KEY in samples/sample-app/README.md line 17.
Onboard Bot: Recommendation list: (A) add an "Auth troubleshooting" note above quickstart curl mentioning inference.read/inference.write and service tokens, (B) add a Windows CMD curl example showing %REDWOOD_API_KEY% quoting, (C) standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY across samples, (D) add a minimal Python retry snippet in Advanced and one-line pointers in Go and Ruby for parity, (E) add a changelog line at top of README.
Harper L: I'll open a micro-PR to implement A-C and add the changelog. Example Windows snippet I'll include: 
```
rem Windows CMD example
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" ^
  -H "Authorization: Bearer %REDWOOD_API_KEY%" ^
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" ^
  -d "{\"model\":\"gpt-redwood-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}"
```
Sam G: For (D) here's a tiny Python retry blurb I'd like to add under "Advanced": 
```python
# basic retry using requests + urllib3 Retry for transient errors and throttling
from requests import Session
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

s = Session()
retry = Retry(total=4, backoff_factor=0.3, status_forcelist=[429,500,502,503,504])
s.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry))
# use s.post(...) or configure SDK client to use this session for automatic retries
```
Harper L: Good. We'll also add a one-liner in other SDK quickstarts: "For long-running processes, enable SDK retry/refresh (see SDK retry docs)". Keeps parity without duplicating full code.
CI Bot: docs-ci: running spellcheck + linkcheck for PR #1415 :eyes: (also will run samples smoke test to verify env var presence).
Sam G: Please also add a tiny CI smoke test that runs the quickstart in samples and validates the env var is set and that quoting examples run on Windows runner. That should catch regressions.
Harper L: Agreed. I'll tag @Sam G on the PR and merge after CI passes. Leaving thread open until merge. :thumbsup:
